config.better_cloud_shadows.title: Better Cloud Shadows
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.cloud: Casts moving shadows on the ground beneath the clouds. Uses Better Clouds' clouds when installed, and vanilla clouds otherwise.
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.affec: Fades out cloud shadows around light sources like torches, lanterns, and campfires.
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.cloud: How dark cloud shadows get. They're always lighter near sunrise/sunset and while it's raining.
How far the edges of cloud shadows blur out, in blocks. Higher cloud layers blur a little more on top of this.
How far shadows slide away from directly under their cloud as the sun gets lower.
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.match: Draws shadows as far as the clouds casting them reach. Turn off to manually set the distance.
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.cloud: How far away cloud shadows are drawn, in blocks. Ignored while Match Cloud Render Distance is on, and capped by the cloud range.
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.dista: Also casts shadows from Distant Horizons' cloud layers. Needs Distant Horizons installed with its cloud rendering turned on.
